newsitem.title: RUSSIA: MinFins edge up after Monday's gains.
newsitem.headline: MinFins edge up after Monday's gains.

text.p: Russian MinFins barely edged up on Tuesday as strong demand for some tranches on Monday ran out of steam and some players took profits, dealers said.
"The buying and selling interest has the character of a correction," said an ICFI Moscow Partners dealer.
Dealers said prices fluctuated during the day as banks covered their short positions and took profits after a strong rise on Monday on news of a new Eurobond issue.
Russia said it would issue a one billion mark Eurobond in March and planned to raise up to $3 billion through Eurobonds in 1997.
Dealers said there was still buying interest from the West that supported the market at current levels.

The ICFI Moscow Partners dealer said prices were likely to rise as the market expected the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee to raise interest rates only slightly when it meets on February 4-5, and prices were already discounting this.
